theorem eq_of_irreducible_of_monic [Nontrivial B] {p : A[X]} (hp1 : Irreducible p)

    p = minpoly A x ↔ Polynomial.aeval x p = 0 :=
  ⟨(· ▸ aeval A x), (eq_of_irreducible_of_monic irr · monic)⟩
